A PROBE THAT WRITES THE WRONG WIDGET KEY SUCCEEDS AND LIES. MpiText's widget is `string`, NOT `value` - writing `.value` adds a key ComfyUI ignores, the node keeps its BAKED default, and the run returns a fluent description of a completely different character with no error. It cost one wrong reading here. Inject the way comfyController._inject does: overwrite only keys that ALREADY exist, never invent one, and PRINT every title that matched nothing.
